checks.name: Real production host exposes unlocked bound selection and changes model without a new run, message or approval
Native switch exit after mutation is recovered by public snapshot without a credential or prompt
Exit before native intent aborts only the unexecuted selection and retains source on restart
Close waits for native mutation ownership, blocks late commit and next host recovers without replay
Archive during model receipt refuses commit and recovery, never reactivates archived conversation
Official model removal refuses selection before native intent or registry mutation
Complete request capacity failure keeps the real source model and has a stable typed UI error
Migration adds baseline to a prior B1 model table idempotently without altering model/history facts
All idle host scenarios preserve the original owned UI source database

boundary: Actual production host/service/SDK/SQLite/JSONL; owned real-UI data copy and controlled official catalogue, no provider completions claimed
